title: Arc Length of an Exponential Equiangular Spiral
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the length of the curve r(t) = <exp(t) cos(t), exp(t) sin(t), exp(t)> from t = 0 to t = ln(2).

steps.title: Differentiate Each Component
steps.mathExpression: x'(t) = e^t(\cos t - \sin t), \quad y'(t) = e^t(\sin t + \cos t), \quad z'(t) = e^t
steps.explanation: Apply product rule to x(t) and y(t).

steps.title: Calculate Speed Magnitude
steps.mathExpression: |\mathbf{v}(t)|^2 = e^{2t} [(\cos t - \sin t)^2 + (\sin t + \cos t)^2 + 1] = e^{2t}[2 + 1] = 3e^{2t} \implies |\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{3}e^t
steps.explanation: Use identity (cos t - sin t)^2 + (sin t + cos t)^2 = 2.
